up: For the assay uniquely identified by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3988443' in the assays table, retrieve all activity measurements (rows from the activities table). For each activity, include the following output columns: the compound identifier (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id) and compound name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), the standard activity type (activities.standard_type), standard relation (activities.standard_relation), standard value (activities.standard_value), standard units (activities.standard_units), and any activity comment (activities.activity_comment). Do not filter by relation, value, units, or any other criteria; return every reported measurement for that assay. The join path is: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, and activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name AS compound_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.activity_comment FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3988443';
